read.thesis: Record $130B Q1 inflows and 8% organic base fee growth with margin up 130bp to 44.5%, but this is an asset manager with no capacity or utilisation signals, so the supply-side lens is largely not applicable.

triggers.label: Record ETF inflows $132B
triggers.quote: record iShares first-quarter net inflows of $132 billion

triggers.label: Effective fee rate up 0.2bp QoQ
triggers.quote: our annualized effective fee rate was 0.2 basis point higher compared to the fourth quarter

triggers.label: Institutional index outflows $35B

guidance.value: at least $450 million per quarter for balance of year
